rule: amendment B-12 items B1-B21 (local; post hoc; confirmatory verdict unchanged)

B3.rule: B-12 B3: a country is flagged when the first GeoNames language of the nearest settlement's country is not among the languages of the blocks applied to it (block languages from the block names); regional flags of v66 B14 unchanged and counted separately

B4.rule: B-12 B4: the five inclusion criteria applied in the order of the protocol

B7r.rule: B-12 B7': the subset's ΔBS times the subset's share of cells, divided by the baseline gain of all cells of the same run

B8.rule: B-12 B8: location-group bootstrap (4,000) of ΔBS(M1→arm), divided by the point baseline gain

B12.rule: B-12 B12: AOIs with GFM labels; window = from 00:00 of the day before the earliest EMS image date to 24:00 of the day after the latest; distinct acquisition days of the GFM frames found in the window, offset from the nearest EMS image day

B13.rule: B-12 B13: polygon descriptions classed by topsem.world.ems.flood_class; trace share = area of flood-trace polygons over all flood polygons in evaluable cells, by the sensor of the EMS map

B14.rule: B-12 B14: evaluable cells of the 500 analysed AOIs (before the cap) that are neither flooded nor dry under the riverine rule (flood cover >= 0.5 but riverine cover < 0.5)

B15.rule: B-12 B15: one definition for the HAND-only map: mean HAND of the cell, lowest first, ties in a random order (v66 B12, corrected run); the other tables take this value. The minimum-HAND map (ties by mean HAND) is a different map and is labelled as such where shown

B16.note: JRC hazard features are not available locally (computed on the cluster); not computed

B5.rule: B-12 B5: the location group with the largest absolute contribution to R in each outlying null replicate (v55), with its country (majority of cells) and flooded share

B10.rule: B-12 B10: second stage refitted on the dumps of B-8 C2 (corrected code, primary split): M1s (no composition), M1c, and M1c without the AOI mean of the character model's score

B17.rule: B-12 B17: held-out Brier of M0 and M1 against the best constant (the test cells' flooded share) and, for k-fold splits, the training-side constant of each fold

B20.rule: B-12 B20: water-related derivations among names read as water-side (p1) and among the others (p0)

B1.rule: B-12 B1: share of outer replicates (new samples) in which each rule declares equivalence (90% interval inside ±0.05; denominator's 95% interval above zero) with the true R set to r0

B9.rule: B-12 B9: the stratified bootstrap of v44 (same seed and replicates) on coder 2's codes

B6.rule: B-12 B6: the estimate surviving BH (v41) and GFM assessability within 500 m by class

B21.rule: B-12 B21: names not read as water-side, nearest to cells within 500 m in the AOIs that hold flooded cells near water-side names, allocated to countries in proportion to those flooded cells; mixed with the B-11 sample in a random order; the key (read or not) is kept private

B19.rule: B-12 B19 (addenda 2 and 3): every version of the water-side odds ratio within 500 m in the corrected census (v69_estimates.csv), including the Sect. 5 estimator versions flagged by keys, without strata, single-activation leave-outs or other classes, with the uncapped estimates of B-11 B2 (pairs intervals); equal values counted once; labels from the path, and for EMS the domain (cells GFM can assess, or all cells)

B8c.rule: B-12 addendum 1: the census of B-11 B8 with odds ratios flagged near settlements also when the node carries n_group_flooded, n_group_cells, n_flooded_near; BH and BY q within the near-settlement family

B21b.rule: B-12 addendum 1 item 3: strata (form x country) of the uncapped sample absent from the B-11 sample, heaviest first, up to three names each, 50 names; mixed into the B21 sample in a random order
B21b.note: share recomputed over unique strata (the first value summed per name); weights sum to 2 over all strata

B18.rule: B-12 B18: the Sect. 5 model (AOI fixed effects, distance bands, logit of M1, water-side × band) on the capped table, with and without the ESA WorldCover built-up share of the cell (10 m)

B2.rule: B-12 B2: uncapped sample of B-11 B2 (corrected readings); countries of the nearest settlement; Pakistan and Bangladesh removed by the activation's countries

B11.rule: B-12 B11: base-logit column scaled by K so that the L2 penalty acts on composition and name features only; C chosen per fold and arm by five inner folds of location groups (inner Brier), grid widened until the optimum is interior
